notes: As for is marked added under rule 16's limit, אֲנִי being a fronted nominal with no marker and no preposition on it; the explicit pronoun keeps only its own me, and folding the whole expression into אֲנִי was the competing reading.
And now divides as rule 14 directs for וְעַתָּה: And to the waw and now to the adverb.
